title: Aid Stations and checkpoint chart — Western States 100
claims: The checkpoint chart lists a cut-off time for each aid station, expressed as the deadline for leaving that station.
Cut-off times are strictly enforced by cutoff coordinators or aid station captains; anyone leaving after the cut-off is disqualified, and a runner who misses the cut-off must stop.
The official note states that cut-off times are not intended to be a pacing guide, and that runners close to the cut-offs are in trouble.
Cut-offs marked with an asterisk are default cut-offs identical to the cut-off at the next aid station.
